title: Rate of convergence of a nonlinear heat equation with a constraint of codimension one
summary: We consider a nonlinear constrained heat flow evolving on the manifold $\mathcal{M}=\{v\in L^{2}:\|v\|_{L^{2}}=1\}$ over bounded smooth domains. It is known that the solution corresponding to any nonnegative initial datum remains on $\mathcal{M}$ and converges to the unique positive ground state of the associated stationary problem.
